rows.grounds: superlative adjective indicating the least or smallest measure in the series
compound specifying a unit of nine tālas
compound indicating one hundred increased by four (veda = four), yielding 104

items.question: What numerical measure in parts is prescribed for the smallest nine-tāla unit?
premises: The smallest unit in this sequence is designated as nine tālas.
Its measure is specified as one hundred increased by four.
The prescribed value is stated as a normative requirement.
items.inference: Therefore, the smallest nine-tāla unit is prescribed to measure one hundred and four parts.
uncertainties: The exact unit of the parts (bhāga or aṅgula) is implied from context but not stated explicitly in this verse.
items.plain_english: The smallest nine-tāla measure should be one hundred and four parts.
